testMethod: Each document cold-launched in installed Demo with debug verify=true; 45 second deadline. Sources copied byte-for-byte into app private cache for automated access. Original Download files not changed. Existing smoke checks ran on loaded documents; text-only search skipped on documents without suitable text. Three HWPX first pages compared visually against embedded original previews; other graphical issues additionally reviewed in source XML and implementation. Loading success is not a fidelity pass. No reader code was changed.
scopeLimit: No claim of pixel-by-pixel review of all pages. Runtime checks and displayed content/fidelity are reported separately.
